objective: Repair observation-unsupported room geometry and source-image texture fidelity while preserving editable components and fixed cameras
allowed_author_inputs: Original 36 mapping RGB images, fixed K/T/model gauge, shared DA3 prediction and original annotations
forbidden_author_inputs: Laser/GT depth, eight heldout images, post-freeze GT scores; no source photos from heldout may be used as texture
split_scope: Previous heldout results have been exposed to the coordinator and user; all reuse is labelled exposed-test diagnostic, not new independent generalization
preservation: Original OURS v1-v3, AWSM v1-v2, protocol, freezes and all outcomes remain unchanged
selection: Authors select using allowed source evidence; freeze before evaluator-only GT scoring; never choose based on new GT score
texture_contract: Surface-bound UV/PBR texture, source/hash provenance, visibility and occlusion checks; no camera billboard, source background replacement or all-scene emission substitution
lighting_contract: Freeze geometry and textures for any separate lighting candidate; photographic texture is captured appearance, not measured intrinsic albedo
geometry_contract: Repair actual mesh and corresponding collision geometry from input evidence, not hide_render exclusions or GT-driven cropping; preserve source labels, tolerances and cameras
native_acceptance: Run actual structural/geometry review, preserve failed or unknown gates; no waiver for intended but undeclared joints
evaluation: Same frozen truth, all44depthviews, all8previouslyheldoutimages plus5fixedinputimages, opaqueZ range0.1to30m, fullmodel100000areaweighted samples, full laser reference, macrodepthaggregation
resources: Models/raw data/textures remain remote; local code, JSON evidence and small previews only
